LensMatch uses advanced 3D facial landmark detection to identify your face shape and mathematically determine the most flattering eyewear frames for your natural contours.\n\nCombined with Franselle Optical Clinic, you can preview frames virtually via Augmented Reality (AR), reserve your frame, and have licensed eye care specialists handle your custom lens prescription and fitting in person.
Eyewear looks most flattering when its silhouette contrasts with your natural face shape, creating visual harmony and symmetry:
Best Frames: Aviator, Wayfarer, Cat-Eye. Most styles look fantastic due to proportional forehead and jaw balance.
Best Frames: Rectangular, Angular, Square. Bold lines add structure, elongate the face, and sharpen softer curves.
Best Frames: Round, Oval, Browline. Curving contours soften angular jawlines and broad foreheads.
Best Frames: Light Aviator, Rimless, Cat-Eye. Balances cheekbone prominence and creates focus across the lower face.
